'''Premiere - Reflections II (Modified)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>premiere_ref2_m</code>). Its card pool is that of [[Premiere - Reflections II]] (Decipher set ids 1&ndash;10 and premium ids 101&ndash;112). Two cards are banned: ''[[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]'' and ''[[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]''.<ref name="gemp" /> It is also called "P-Reflections II (w/ WYS and AOBS banned)".<ref name="t82167" /><ref name="t84007" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />
